yaadira-brown.name: Yaadira Brown
yaadira-brown.excerpt: I saw the great reviews and decided to fill out the quote form. Within the hour, I received a call… all of my data, particularly my photos, have been recovered!
yaadira-brown.text:
I can’t even begin to explain how happy I am while typing this review. So a few months ago around the anniversary of my grandmother’s passing, I went to pull up my Photos library (located on my external drive) and the drive would take forever to show up on the MacBook and then freeze when I would try to access files. I tried troubleshooting here and there for months until I decided that it needed to be assessed by a professional.

I initially reached out to a company based in California that worked on a laptop of mine previously. But ideally, I wanted to find someone local that could help me and for a reasonable price. I happened to come across Disk Doctors. I saw the great reviews and decided to fill out the quote form. Within the hour, I received a call from Mr. Shahid who walked me through the process for evaluating my device and even though it was the weekend, he set up for a technician to pick up my device to begin running a diagnostic. The diagnostic was done by the next day and he told me exactly what he thought the issue was and next steps for recovering my data. I decided to move forward and I am happy to say that all of my data, particularly my photos, have been recovered!

The process was simple and quick, the customer service and communication were amazing, the price was competitive, and most of all the results are great! I am so grateful to Mr. Shahid and the Disk Doctors team. I hope I don’t have any more technology issues in the future but if I do, I will define returning! Definitely recommend this company for any data recovery services!
